== Biography ==
Marion Glasgow was baptised on 6 April 1740 at Covington and Thankerton, daughter of George Glasgow and Agnes Williamson. The two derivative entries record her as female and supply indexed birth year1740, without an exact birthday.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685660801&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-r-685660801], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref><ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_689421003&tab=this Findmypast fmp-record-r-689421003], inspected derivative transcript,25October2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
